notes.title: Demo and Tiny Teams!
notes.content: [p]We're excited to announce that the Reality Drift demo, which has just been released, is part of the Tiny Teams festival![/p][p]Tiny Teams is a festival all about celebrating games made by solo developers and micro-studios, from already popular indie hits, to hidden gems and what could be the next "big thing.”[/p][p]The Tiny Teams 2025 festival will run from 7th-14th of August on Steam! You can see all the games in the event by clicking this link: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams 2025 Steam event[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Reality Drift demo![/h3][p]The demo has four of the full game's 25 missions, including two roguelike deckbuilding missions. You'll meet three bizarre characters including the tyrannical Vincenzo, Prince of the Fungus Kingdom![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45189833/ae552d5072ca85fcb50db1a7cd259ff0e617db38.jpg"][/img][/p][p]What possible reason could you have NOT to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522340/Reality_Drift_Demo/" style="button"]click on this button to download the demo[/url] right now?[/p][p]If you played the demo before August 9th 2025, we have made changes based on player feedback, including adjusting the difficulty of the first three missions, and altering tracks such as Space and Heaven to help the player see upcoming corners better, plus a number of other improvements![/p]

notes.title: Roguelike deckbuilding mode!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work on Reality Drift, and we have a new mission type to show you! For a long time we wanted to incorporate some kind of roguelike deckbuilding into the game, but couldn't figure out how to make it work. Well, now we've figured it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45189833/034f3a8cd270ad5ea65e67e923d5103342bee37e.png[/img]

In some missions, the player starts with a deck of cards, each of which has an effect while drawn. Two or three cards (depending on the mission) are drawn at the start of each track, and are discarded at the end of the track. Some cards make temporary or permanent changes to your stats, while some have conditional effects, such as "For every 5 seconds driving offroad, gain +5 GRIP".

We've been testing this new mode, and it works really well - the next step is to add more cards, and work on making sure the game is balanced. There will also be updates to the visuals - the card graphics in the current screenshot are placeholder.

In other news, we'll be at the Norwich Games Festival in the UK at the end of May!

notes.title: Reality Drift is coming to Cambridge and Hastings!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45189833/9eced5513cf2a52136513cfbe435f06079b9023a.jpg[/img]

We're going to be demoing Reality Drift at two upcoming events in the UK!

Saturday 7th December 2024: We'll be at the Family Gaming Night at the Centre for Computing History in Cambridge. Book in advance at [url=https://www.computinghistory.org.uk/]computinghistory.org.uk[/url]

24th/25th January 2025: We'll be at the Hastings Games Fest - get tickets [url=https://whiterocktheatre.org.uk/whats-on/event/games-fest/]here[/url]

Meanwhile we're making progress on the game - if you want to see what we're doing but can't come to one of those events, you can get updates via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/arganoid.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url].

notes.title: We demoed Reality Drift at the Portsmouth Games Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45189833/9eced5513cf2a52136513cfbe435f06079b9023a.jpg[/img]

Shortly after launching our Steam page, we let members of the public play the game at the Portsmouth Games Fest. We had a wide range of people trying the game, including the very special guest you can see above!

The response from players was great, and we got a ton of signups to our mailing list. Here are a few comments from kids who played the game:

"That is honestly amazing"

"That's so many cats!"

"It's actually a really good game"

We only wish we'd written down more of the comments, as there were many more like this!

We're currently looking into attending the Hastings Games Fest in January 2025, so check back soon for more news on that.
